translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Onger Akaba
book.title: Godɨn Ziam Fer Onger Akabar Akɨnafarim O Onger Akaba

content: God gumazamizir kuraba abɨnigha, gumazamizir aghuibar akura
Gumazir ighiabar faragha zuim a gumazamizibav kɨmtɨ, me tiarir kamɨn gɨn mangɨ ighiar kam bangam, “Gumazitam gasɨghasɨghan markɨ.”

content.text: O God, e zurara nɨ mɨnaba egha nɨn ziam fe.
E nɨn ziar ekiamɨn gun mɨgɨa,
bizir igharagha garir nɨ amibagh eghari.
God kamaghɨn mɨgɨa ghaze,
“Kɨ kotiamɨn dughiar mam amɨsevegha gɨvazɨma a iti.
Nan kotiam guizbangɨra zui.
Egha ifarir puvatɨ.
Nguazir kam, mɨkɨmkɨzim a batoghtɨ,
an itir gumazamiziba akongam.
Nguazimɨn mɨngarir apengan itim,
kɨ an suiraghtɨ a ikɨ gavgavigham.

content: (Ighiam gamua an suiamatugha avughsegha uaighiam gami.)

content.text: Kɨ gumazamizir akaba batogha pura uan ziaba febav gɨa ghaze,
‘Ia uari fɨva akaba batoghan markɨ.’
Kɨ gumazamizir kurabav gɨa ghaze,
‘Ia uarira uan gavgavibagh nɨghnɨgh uan ziaba fan markɨ.
Ia uan gavgavibagh nɨghnɨgh da bagh ifaghatan markɨ.
Egh pamten akabagh itɨ, dɨbovir akabar na mɨkɨman markɨ.’ ”
Gumazamizibar araziba tuisɨghamin gumazitam, an
aruem anadi naghɨn ko, aruem uaghiri naghɨn ko, not ko sautɨn amadaghan ikɨva otoghan kogham.
Puvatɨgham.
God uabɨra en araziba tuisɨsi.
A gumazamizir maba fa, igharaziba abɨri.
Ikiavɨra Itir Godɨn anɨngagharim kamaghɨn iti.
A kavɨn mamɨn suira, ezɨ wainɨn igiar gavgavir ekiam itim a gizɨfa.
An a ingezɨ gumazamizir kuraba anepa bar anegɨfa.
Arazir kamra, gumazamizir kuraba Godɨn kotɨn otivigh, egh bar gevegham.
Kɨ uabɨ zurara Jekopɨn God bagh ighiaba bangɨvɨra ikɨ an ziam fam.
Egh an akabar gun mɨkɨmam.
Eghtɨ God gumazamizir kurabar gavgaviba bar ada gɨvagham.
Egh an damazimɨn derazir gumazamiziba, a gavgavim ua me danɨngam.
